text:
Nora: Uploaded the latest launch post draft (v6) -> https://drive.re/redwood/launch-v6. Need quick eyes on the hero latency claim + CTA routing. Thinking: lead with 'median ~45ms' and show p95 in a technical badge.
Phil: Looking now. Are those numbers from warm cache + auto-batching? We should call that out.
Nora: Yes, warm cache and the auto-batcher was on for the Hosted numbers in the hero. Cold-starts are in the appendix.
Asha: Legal: any p95 claim needs reproducible steps, hardware list, and a clear measurement window. Avoid words like "instant" or "best-in-class."
Dmitri: I'll paste the bench command and link logs. bench: `./run_bench --model redwood-xl --seq 1024 --batch 2 --runs 150 --device a100 --cache warm --autobatch` Logs: https://ci.re/redwood/launch-v6-logs
Phil: For GTM, median-led headline is cleaner. Include the p95 badge and a short explainer for SREs in the sidebar.
Asha: Legal will sign off if appendix includes dataset sample, RNG seed, kernel flags, and request mix. @Dmitri can you add a tiny CSV sample and seed?
Dmitri: Yep. Adding GPU table, kernel flags, RNG seed=1337, and a 10-row request CSV to the appendix. Also linking raw CSV of run latencies.
Nora: CTA: webinar signup should flow to webinar list + trial nurturing. Tag inbound leads `launch-v6` and set followups at days 3 and 9. @GrowthBot can you create that routing?
GrowthBot: Routing created: form -> webinar-list + trial-nurture. Tag attached: `launch-v6`. Followups scheduled: day 3, day 9. Confirm to enable.
Nora: Enable it. Also need a quick sign-off on the hero quote from the VP Eng, removed absolutes already. @Phil can you ok the phrasing?
Phil: Edited slightly to say "in our tests" and removed absolutes. Approved :white_check_mark:
Asha: Conditional legal OK once appendix link is live in the draft and the measurement blurb is present.
Dmitri: Appendix live with commands, hardware table, prompt mix, RNG seed, and a short variance note.
Nora: Great. Final publish window set for tomorrow 10:15 PT, embargo reminder in the header. I'm locking the doc in 10m. Anything else?
Phil: Growth ready on social and landing copy. I'll QA the UTM tags.
Asha: All clear from legal after appendix verification.
Nora: Locking doc now. Thanks all! :rocket:
